copy.heading: Jobs I can do

items: Put the bins out on the right night.
Loaded the dishwasher without being told how afterwards.
Mowed the lawn without mowing a green into the middle of it.
Rung the man about the gutter.
Cooked a meal that was not a barbecue.
Done bath time and bedtime on my own, including the second story and the glass of water.
Changed a duvet cover without getting inside it.

copy.instructions: Tick each job you have done since arriving. Sue will countersign.
body: During your posting the following jobs were done by other people. The Programme would like you to learn them in order of difficulty.
